outcome.Summary: Added api/handler.go implementing NewHandler(s *Store) http.Handler using Go 1.24 method-pattern ServeMux routes: GET /healthz (text/plain "ok"), POST/GET /notes (title required, 201 on create, list with ?q= case-insensitive filter returning [] when empty), and GET/DELETE /notes/{id} (404 missing, 400 non-integer id, 204 delete), with JSON error bodies and 405 for other methods. Added api/handler_test.go covering all endpoints via net/http/httptest. Verified with `go vet ./... && go test ./... -count=1`, which passes.
